question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

60, 80, 64, 70, 68, 60, ?, 50
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: [Contain two separate series. In first series, 4 is added in first, third & fifth number. In second series 10 subtract in second, fourth & sixth number]**
